## Walkthrough This PR updates OpenShift manifest annotations across two files to migrate from a legacy feature-set annotation to the standardized feature-gate annotation. ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding RBAC resources, along with the Deployment resource, all replace their `feature-set: "TechPreviewNoUpgrade,CustomNoUpgrade"` annotations with `feature-gate: "ClusterAPIMachineManagement"`. ## Changes **Feature-gate migration for ClusterAPIMachineManagement** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **RBAC manifest annotations**
`manifests/01-rbac-capi.yaml` | ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding annotations are updated from `include.release.openshift.io/feature-set` to `include.release.openshift.io/feature-gate: "ClusterAPIMachineManagement"`. | | **Deployment manifest annotations**
`manifests/04-deployment-capi.yaml` | Deployment metadata annotations remove the `release.openshift.io/feature-set` annotation and add `release.openshift.io/feature-gate: "ClusterAPIMachineManagement"`. | ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes
